# Crimson Desert Item Name Catalogue

Source snapshot as retrieved: 2026-11-13. The limits export identifies its source as `live_game_memory_v2`.

Source evidence: [item names JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NattKh/CrimsonDesertCommunityItemMapping/main/item_names.json), [item limits JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NattKh/CrimsonDesertCommunityItemMapping/main/data/item_limits.json), [community repository README](https://github.com/NattKh/CrimsonDesertCommunityItemMapping).

Rows are joined by numeric `itemKey` to the numeric key in the limits export. Each cell contains the source JSON scalar token; string tokens are HTML-escaped, numeric tokens are unchanged, `null` remains `null`, and a blank cell means that field is absent from that source record.

## Coverage

| Measure | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Name records | 6325 |
| Unique numeric itemKey values | 6325 |
| Matched name keys | 5892 |
| Name-only keys | 433 |
| Metadata-only IDs | 7 |
| Duplicate name records (beyond first occurrence per numeric itemKey) | 0 |
| Limits metadata records | 5899 |

## Coverage limitations

This is community data with mixed provenance, not an authoritative or independently game-verified complete inventory. It is the full source snapshot only, not all game items or a categorized equipment catalogue. VULKK raw HTML returned HTTP 403 here; no challenge was bypassed.

## Patch-sensitive caveats

The exports are a snapshot and may change with game patches or later community updates. Numeric category and slot meanings are undocumented, so codes are preserved verbatim without translation or inferred classification.
